cuts.ofreeRecent: a riverside pavilion tower over the Yangtze — holds a gourd-shaped wine flask on a red cord by its cord at chest height; her tower bedchamber in a stone castle — lying on her front; a riverside seating area waiting for festival fireworks — standing; a chandelier ballroom at a masquerade — holds a cocktail glass by the stem at chest height; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — raises a small red paper lantern beside her face so its glow lights her cheek; a candlelit gala dinner hall — seated on a chair; a pilot ready room beside a hangar — shakes a gourd-shaped wine flask on a red cord by her ear to hear how much wine is left; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — standing; a floating sky garden of hanging vines and flowering terraces above the clouds — holds a small bouquet in both hands at her waist; the upper balcony of a wooden pavilion with upturned eaves — lifts a small hand lantern to chest height; an old brush-and-ink shop in a heritage quarter — carries a small storage box against her waist; an outdoor court for tennis or basketball — standing; a grand museum hall with marble statues at night — standing
